sources.section: Full json_config dict possibilities; Export path wildcards
sources.facts: The preset form {name, maps[].{fileName, channels[].{destChannel, srcChannel, srcMapType, srcMapName}, parameters}}; the documentMap, virtualMap names and the $mesh and $textureSet wildcards of unreal-engine-packed, whose maps this variant repeats.

sources.page: Unreal Engine 5.6 documentation, texture import and texture properties (approved source X-CONSUMERS)
sources.section: Texture sRGB flag and compression settings; normal maps; DDS 2D import
sources.facts: DDS 2D textures are importable; colour textures are sampled with the sRGB flag, packed data and normal maps without it; BC pass-through through cooking is not documented (docs/analysis/technology-options/05-review-response.md finding 13), so the DDS is compact interchange until the consumer fixture records it.

sources.page: Microsoft DDS and DXGI_FORMAT documentation (approved source S-DDS-MS); docs/DDS.md
sources.facts: The DX10 header and the BC5 (R, G), BC7 and BC7 sRGB (sRGB R, G, B, linear A) formats the DDS companions are stored in.

sources.page: UzPainter decision 023 (owner answer Q10); docs/architecture/08-export.md §4 Unreal Engine (Packed); decision 322
sources.facts: An optional DDS encoding: BC7 for BaseColor, ORM and Emissive, BC5 for Normal; canonical 16-bit maps are written beside cooked derivatives (EXP-10); SpecularWeight is exported and reported as a consumer gap.

sources.page: Recording R-322 (decision 322): export-presets-unreal-packed-legacy and -ocio, Painter 12.2.0, on the UzmiGames-authored bevelled cube
sources.section: ResourceExportPreset.list_output_maps of the versioned starter-assets URL; dry-run lists and exports of five configurations, r1 and r2
sources.facts: Confirms, never sources: the URL resource://starter_assets/Unreal Engine (Packed)?version=8339356058946582545.spexp; four maps BaseColor (RGB baseColor, A opacity), OcclusionRoughnessMetallic (R AO_Mixed, G roughness, B metallic), Normal (Normal_DirectX) and Emissive (emissive), each named $mesh_$textureSet_<map>(_$colorSpace)(.$udim) at PNG 8, dithering on the Normal only; no padding (own parameters raise 'padding algorithm could not be resolved'); no SpecularWeight map; under OCIO the names end _sRGB (BaseColor, Emissive) and _Raw (OcclusionRoughnessMetallic, Normal); TGA 8 files equal the PNG 8 files in decoded values on every map, r1 = r2.

packing.decision: The channels of unreal-engine-packed's BaseColor at PNG 16 (the DDS's canonical file), with a BC7_SRGB DDS beside it, colour mips (sRGB-aware averaging; no cutout is assumed for the alpha)
packing.source: decision 023 (BC7 BaseColor); decision 322; docs/DDS.md (RequestDds); packing of unreal-engine-packed, confirmed by R-322

packing.decision: The channels of unreal-engine-packed's ORM at PNG 16 with a linear BC7 DDS beside it, linear mips; AO_Mixed is computed in decisions 411, 418 and 419's scope and refused outside it
packing.source: decision 023 (BC7 ORM); decision 322; packing of unreal-engine-packed, confirmed by R-322

packing.decision: Normal_DirectX at PNG 16 with a BC5 DDS beside it (R and G stored), renormalised normal mips; negative-Z texels refused before compression
packing.source: decision 023 (BC5 Normal); docs/DDS.md (BC5 negative-Z refusal); packing of unreal-engine-packed, confirmed by R-322

packing.decision: The channels of unreal-engine-packed's Emissive at PNG 16 with a BC7_SRGB DDS beside it, colour mips
packing.source: decision 023 (BC7 Emissive); decision 322; packing of unreal-engine-packed, confirmed by R-322

packing.decision: L from documentMap specularweight at PNG 16, written when the stack has the channel, with no DDS (decision 023 names no BC format for it); the receipt reports it as a consumer gap

Selected by its UzPainter id only (no Painter preset answers to it); each DDS is <stem>.dds beside its PNG 16 canonical file, cooked from that file's samples; no map dithers (a canonical PNG 16 file); padding comes from exportParameters
packing.source: decision 322; docs/DDS.md; packing of unreal-engine-packed, confirmed by R-322

pending.what: The packing repeats unreal-engine-packed's, whose layout R-322 confirms; the DDS companions are UzPainter's own encoding and are accepted by the UE 5.6 consumer fixture (items 2.8 and 3.3), not by a Painter recording.
